prompt: What should appear in the setup record over two mornings if the wall is identical on the first morning but a print moves on the second, with its card text unchanged?
promptZh: 如果第一天早上牆面配置不變，第二天移動一幅作品但不改卡片文字，兩天各該留下什麼紀錄？

options.text: A “same layout” entry on both mornings.
options.whyZh: 第二天作品移位，即使文字不變，牆面配置也變了。

options.text: A “same layout” entry first, then only a new wide image.
options.zh: 第一天寫「配置不變」，第二天只拍新的全景照。
options.whyZh: 第一天做法正確，但第二天變動須另拍一張標籤特寫。

options.text: A “same layout” entry first, then both new photographs.
options.zh: 第一天寫「配置不變」，第二天重拍兩張照片。
options.whyZh: 第一天配置未變只需登記；第二天作品移位，即使標籤文字未變，仍須重拍全景與特寫。

options.text: Two new photographs first, then just a new close image.
options.zh: 第一天重拍兩張，第二天只重拍特寫。
options.whyZh: 第一天不須重拍；第二天缺少顯示變動的全景照。

explanationZh: 第一天配置未變只需登記；第二天作品移位，即使標籤文字未變，仍須重拍全景與特寫。
evidence: Take and keep a new pair even if only one corner of the wall has changed. / For no-change days, write “same layout” in the log; there is no need to take new photos.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Take and keep a new pair even if only one corner of the wall has changed.
For no-change days, write “same layout” in the log; there is no need to take new photos.

vocabulary.note: 指靠近物件拍出的畫面，便於閱讀細節。
